text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you so much! Be on the
lookout for
more Falco!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon manages to secure center
stage in a
magnificent winning concert.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: 素晴らしいライブだった！

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...It just doesn't feel real. I can hardly
believe it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm super happy I got to sing in front of
everyone.
It felt great to have the
spotlight on me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The lights the audience was waving...
They were
all for me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Their cheers, their gazes... they were all
honed in
on center stage—on me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I knew winning concerts were amazing.
But still...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Singing center stage is somehow even
more fun
than I thought!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: 大きなステージならもっと楽しい

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I wanna perform on an even bigger
stage! I wanna
be a top Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her first time center stage seems to have

strengthened her resolve to reach the
top.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: なろう、トップウマドル！
